compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: The song recalls care and protection in a desert land.
observations.label: Found and guarded

observations.body: The song pictures wilderness care through finding, encircling, guarding, and an eagle’s movement.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Deuteronomy 32:8–12 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Protective imagery is strong while the song keeps its poetry rather than explaining each image.
payload.title: Found in a waste howling wilderness
